title: Local Assistant fixed ActionJournal container layout

header.initialization: new exact-size all-zero container only; write full header; FlushFileBuffers; exact readback; never overwrite an existing or ambiguous container

bank.events_digest_formula: SHA-256(container-domain || 'events' || NUL || container-id || concat(uint32-le-length || event-digest || canonical-event-bytes))
bank.event_sequence: one to sixteen exact v0.1.0 protocol events, beginning prepare/prepared at sequence zero and following exact action/state/resolution/authorization transitions

generation.two_committed_banks: higher generation must be exactly lower plus one and bind lower generation, commit digest, operation id, and exact one-event history extension

write_protocol: validate event, exact history extension, capacity, generation, offsets, and fixed sizes before writes
write a checksummed STAGING marker into the inactive bank
FlushFileBuffers and exact-readback the STAGING marker
write the entire fixed-size inactive bank body
FlushFileBuffers and exact-readback plus validate the bank body
write the checksummed COMMITTED marker containing the body digest
FlushFileBuffers and exact-readback plus validate the complete bank

startup.unused_bank: marker and body are all zero
startup.staged_bank: valid marker only; ignore its body and retain the exact predecessor committed authority
startup.committed_bank: marker, body, checksums, slot/bank/generation, operation id, event cells, event digests, and event history all validate
startup.selection: select the highest exact valid committed bank
startup.caps: fail closed above 256 active or 768 terminal records

future_windows_requirements.handle: precreated identity-validated regular file held for helper lifetime with deny-write/delete sharing
future_windows_requirements.path: owner, DACL, reparse, volume, file-id, link-count, exact-size, and path/handle identity validation before activation
future_windows_requirements.writes: checked offsets and complete bounded writes only
future_windows_requirements.durability: FlushFileBuffers at every specified barrier; exact handle-based readback after each flush
future_windows_requirements.crash_acceptance: power-loss, process-death, storage-fault, and sector-write behavior must be independently tested on exact Windows target before activation
